title: Website Redesign Checklist for Small Businesses

cover.alt: Concept illustration of website page tiles moving along brass tracks between an existing and redesigned structure.

figures.title: Carry useful assets into the redesign
figures.summary: Decide what happens to existing pages before rebuilding them.

items.label: Inventory
items.detail: List existing pages, incoming traffic, search queries, and backlinks.

items.label: Classify
items.detail: Mark each page to keep, update, merge, or remove.

items.label: Map
items.detail: Pair changing URLs with relevant destinations and preserve useful content.

items.label: Verify
items.detail: Test redirects, internal links, and retained content on the new site.

figures.caption: A preservation workflow distilled from the article; it does not promise a ranking outcome.

figures.title: Keep measurement connected to launch
figures.summary: Use the same baseline to make post-launch checks meaningful.

items.label: Before launch
items.detail: Record traffic and search performance, then test the staging site.

items.label: Launch
items.detail: Deploy redirects, check tracking, and submit the new sitemap.

items.label: First week
items.detail: Review crawl errors and confirm old URLs reach their intended destinations.

items.label: Following months
items.detail: Compare like-for-like periods and investigate unexpected changes.

figures.caption: Monitoring checkpoints from the checklist, not a guaranteed recovery schedule.
